title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella tells industry: Software is not going anywhere but ...
key_facts: Satya Nadella wrote in a post on X that people spend much of their work time 'working around software' and AI helps organise software around the work.
He cited GitHub: as agentic development has grown, GitHub has seen accelerating repo creation and pull request and commit activity.
He argued more agents make trusted places to maintain information (systems of record) more important.
Microsoft's ambition is to make Copilot 'a new OS for work' spanning every model, form factor and task.
He said Microsoft announced 30+ new Copilot skills across Dynamics 365 Sales, Service and Customer Insights.
He also pointed to Microsoft Copilot Managed Runtime, which hosts code inside a company's environment under IT governance.
He says all this can reset business software ('infinite SaaS factory').
quote_evidence: So much of what we do at work is still spent working around software.
The lesson is that more agents don't make systems of record less important.
It's why our ambition is to make Copilot a new OS for work that spans every model, every form factor, and every task.
why_it_matters_hint: Microsoft's chief answers fears that AI agents will make business software obsolete, but it is a company claim.
event_date: 9 Oct 2026 (X post as reported); exact post date not stated
notes: Times of India page read from the fetched copy in tmpq05 (the pool fulltext was empty). Article is a summary of Nadella's X post.
